title.narrative: Efficiency audit for Community Development Fund
Efficiency audit for Community Development Fund

description.narrative: This efficiency audit aims at assessing whether the Community Development Fund (CDF) internal control systems are adequate to ensure quality and accuracy for managing the process of the grants assessment cycle for sub-granting funds. At an overall level, the aim is to assess whether CDF has appropriate systems and routines for managing the grants assessment cycle to achieve the operational goals. The efficiency audit is expected to find eventual weaknesses and to suggest actions to address these.
